acceptance.criterion_verbatim: AR345-y-AC1: driver_check.py runs node --check fwd1_driver.mjs, python -m py_compile fwd1_mint.py, then node fwd1_driver.mjs --selftest, and prints DRIVER-OK <n> selftest cases only when all three succeed and the selftest printed SELFTEST-OK <n> cases with n at least 12; otherwise DRIVER-BAD <why> and exit 1.
acceptance.output_evidence: DRIVER-OK 29 selftest cases (exit 0); the self-test printed SELFTEST-OK 29 cases, and every one of its 29 case lines reads PASS
acceptance.denominator: 3 steps (node --check, py_compile, selftest) of which 3 succeeded; 29 selftest cases against the floor of 12

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: AR345-y-AC2 (the one mutant that fails): mutant_check.py copies fwd1_driver.mjs to a scratch folder OUTSIDE the product tree with the guard changed to admit EVERY POST, runs that copy's --selftest, and prints MUTANT-FIRES only when that run FAILS (else MUTANT-SURVIVES, exit 1).
acceptance.output_evidence: MUTANT-FIRES every-POST guard: selftest rc=1; SELFTEST-BAD refuse POST /api/scoped/tickets/abc/claim; refuse POST /api/scoped/tickets/abc/complete (exit 0)
acceptance.denominator: 1 mutant (the POST branch of the guard, one marker found exactly once); the mutant's self-test fails 2 of its 29 cases, the two POST refusals of the claim and complete routes

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: AR345-y-AC3: hash_check.py imports the hashing function of fwd1_mint.py (import-safe: no AWS at import), hashes a random password, and prints HASH-OK scheme=2b cost=12 python=ok bcryptjs=<ok|ABSENT> only when the hash starts with $2b$12$ (or $2a$12$), verifies with python bcrypt, and, when a bcryptjs package exists in any node_modules of this worktree (the portal's or the auth handler's), also verifies with it through node -e; bcryptjs=ABSENT is printed (not a failure) when none is found; it never prints the password or the hash; otherwise HASH-BAD <why> and exit 1.
acceptance.denominator: 1 random password; checks: prefix $2b$12$, python bcrypt verify, a negative control with a wrong password, and bcryptjs in 2 candidate node_modules folders (ABSENT in both)
